evidence_text: Clause 5.6.1 of IS 456 specifies high strength deformed steel bars conforming to IS 1786 for reinforced concrete construction.
Clause 5.1(a) of IS 456 specifies 33, 43, and 53 grade Ordinary Portland Cement conforming to IS 269 as standard cementitious binder.
Clause 9.1.1 of IS 456 references IS 10262 for standard guidelines and calculations on concrete mix proportioning.
Section 2 and Table 1 of IS 800 specify hot-rolled medium and high tensile structural steel conforming to IS 2062 for structural steelwork design.
Section 2 of IS 800 lists steel tubes conforming to IS 1239 (Part 1) as approved tubular structural hollow sections.
IS 10262 is established to fulfill concrete mix design requirements stipulated in IS 456:2000.
IS 10262 cites IS 269 for OPC cement standard characteristics when calculating target mean compressive strength and water-cement ratios.
IS 1786 reinforcement bars are dimensioned and detailed according to structural concrete design rules in IS 456.
Structural steel members manufactured to IS 2062 are designed and fabricated in accordance with IS 800 code of practice.
Companion BIS specification for larger diameter water, gas, and sewage steel pipes (168.3 mm to 2540 mm OD) complementing IS 1239 small bore tubes.
Structural tubular applications of IS 1239 steel tubes are designed per IS 800 code of practice.
Companion BIS specification for smaller diameter steel tubes and distribution piping (up to 150 mm NB) complementing IS 3589 bulk transmission pipes.
Companion low-voltage power distribution cable standard providing PVC insulation alternative for voltages up to 1100 V.
Allied electrical cable standard for internal building wiring and lighting circuits (up to 450/750 V).
Companion low-voltage power distribution cable standard providing XLPE insulation alternative for voltages up to 1100 V.
Allied electrical cable standard for domestic and commercial installation wiring (up to 450/750 V).
Allied heavy-duty cable standard for mains incoming power supply (up to 1100 V).
Allied industrial personal protective equipment (PPE) standard for comprehensive site safety (head protection paired with safety footwear).
Allied industrial personal protective equipment (PPE) standard for comprehensive site safety (safety footwear paired with industrial safety helmets).
